title: Preparation of different phase structure nano sized FePO4/C cathode material by ultrasonic-assisting and their electrochemical performance
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,6281-6290
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00107B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chunmei Tang, Wei Ma, Jichuan Huo, Shuxin Liu
Nano-sized FePO4·2H2O/C and FePO4/C cathode materials with different phase composition were prepared by carbon black preoxidation and ultrasonic-assisting technique. Among all samples, amorphous structure has the best electrochemical performance.
